disclaimer: These dietary suggestions represent general educational nutritional guidance and are not a substitute for medical advice or prescribed therapy.

rules.title: Glucose Management Support
rules.summary: Focus on high-fiber whole foods and complex carbohydrates.
rules.explanation: Elevated fasting blood glucose suggests prioritizing foods that digest slowly and provide sustained energy without sharp glycemic spikes.
rules.limit_explanation: Consider moderating simple sweets, refined flours, and sugary syrups.

rules.title: Proactive Glucose Awareness
rules.summary: Support metabolic balance with dietary fiber and balanced meal composition.
rules.explanation: Borderline fasting glucose is an opportune time to build consistent meal timing with abundant fiber and lean proteins.
rules.limit_explanation: Limit sugary desserts and sweetened beverages.

rules.title: Long-Term Glycemic Balance
rules.summary: Emphasize dietary fiber, whole grains, and portion-conscious complex carbohydrates.
rules.explanation: HbA1c reflects average blood sugar over approximately 90 days. Soluble fiber from legumes and vegetables can assist in gradual glucose absorption.
rules.limit_explanation: Minimize frequent intake of sugary foods and refined bakery items.

rules.title: Glycemic Health Maintenance
rules.summary: Pair carbohydrates with protein and fiber to smooth glycemic response.
rules.explanation: Borderline HbA1c benefits from wholesome Indian staples like whole pulses, salads, and vegetable sabzis.
rules.limit_explanation: Be mindful of hidden sugars in packaged snacks and mithais.

rules.title: Heart-Friendly Lipid Support
rules.summary: Incorporate soluble fiber and choose unsaturated cooking fats.
rules.explanation: Soluble fiber acts like a sponge in the digestive tract, helping bind cholesterol. Oats, beans, and plenty of greens are excellent choices.
rules.limit_explanation: Limit deep-fried farsans, heavily buttered dishes, and excessive ghee.

rules.title: Lipid Profile Optimization
rules.summary: Add fiber-rich vegetables and handfuls of raw nuts.
rules.explanation: Borderline LDL can frequently be moderated by switching to heart-conscious preparations with roasted seeds and fresh vegetables.
rules.limit_explanation: Cut back on deep-fried street snacks.

rules.title: Protective HDL Elevation Support
rules.summary: Focus on healthy monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acid sources.
rules.explanation: HDL is considered protective cholesterol. Incorporating nuts, seeds, and omega-3 sources like flaxseeds or fish supports healthy levels.
rules.limit_explanation: Avoid trans-fat rich items like commercially baked goods.

rules.title: Triglyceride Moderation Guidance
rules.summary: Reduce simple sugars, refined carbs, and include omega-3 fatty acids.
rules.explanation: Elevated triglycerides are responsive to lowering intake of sweetened drinks, syrups, and alcohol while increasing fiber and omega-3s.
rules.limit_explanation: Significantly reduce sweets, sugary syrups, and fried foods.

rules.title: Triglyceride Balance
rules.summary: Choose whole grain alternatives and fiber-dense foods.
rules.explanation: Borderline triglycerides benefit from substituting refined flours with whole wheat, millets, and pulses.
rules.limit_explanation: Moderate mithai, soda, and sweet treats.

rules.title: Dietary Iron Support
rules.summary: Include iron-dense foods paired with natural vitamin C sources.
rules.explanation: Lower haemoglobin values warrant incorporating plant iron sources like palak (spinach), methi, legumes, and seeds, paired with lemon/citrus to enhance non-heme iron absorption.

rules.title: Vitamin D Food Sources
rules.summary: Include fortified dairy, eggs, and consider physician-guided supplementation.
rules.explanation: Because dietary sources of vitamin D are naturally limited, including fortified milk, paneer, and eggs is helpful, though safe sunlight exposure or medical advice is often recommended.

rules.title: Vitamin D Reinforcement
rules.summary: Maintain regular intake of dairy, eggs, and outdoor morning sunlight.
rules.explanation: Borderline vitamin D can be supported through daily curd, milk, and outdoor activity.

rules.title: Vitamin B12 Dietary Sources
rules.summary: Emphasize dairy foods (curd, paneer, milk), eggs, or fish based on your diet.
rules.explanation: Vitamin B12 is synthesized primarily in animal-derived products. For vegetarians, consistent intake of dairy (milk, dahi, paneer) is essential. Vegans should discuss supplementation with their physician.

rules.title: Vitamin B12 Maintenance
rules.summary: Include curd, paneer, and fermented dairy products in your daily routine.
rules.explanation: Borderline B12 levels benefit from consistent inclusion of probiotic dahi, milk, or fortified nutritional foods.
